name: FTUE sound choice modal gates mute and holds the coach until answered
description: bob is the FTUE user (gamesPlayed === 0), so the SOUND CHECK modal must be the first thing he sees. Covers both branches: PLAY WITHOUT SOUND must mute the game, PLAY WITH SOUND must leave it unmuted and start the title music. ALSO covers the regression where the lobby FTUE coach rendered BEHIND the modal and started its typing loop before the user had been asked about audio at all. NOTE on method: resource-timing is useless for this - Vite dev serves asset imports as JS module wrappers, so typing1.ogg shows a fetch at ~89ms regardless of playback. And new Audio() is detached, so querySelectorAll('audio') is always 0. The two valid signals are (a) .lb2-coach absent from the DOM, since BballTip starts its typing loop on mount, and (b) an HTMLMediaElement.play() spy left dwelling while the modal is up - the typing loop re-calls play() every clip, so an active loop cannot hide from it. Ends on the unmuted branch so bob is left in a sane state.

steps._comment: bob has gamesPlayed 0 -> isFtue true. carol has played, so she never sees this modal.
Force a real reload - HMR has served a stale client bundle in this repo before.
ASSERTION 1: the modal opens at start. showSoundChoice also requires audioPreferenceLoaded, so this covers the async user.init settling.

ASSERTION 2 (the regression): the FTUE coach must NOT be mounted while the sound-choice modal is up. BballTip fires _typingAudio.play() from a mount effect, so a coach here means audible typing before the user has been asked about audio.
The tap-catcher ships with the coach block - its absence confirms the whole FTUE coach subtree is held, not just the bubble.

steps.expression: (() => { const coach = document.querySelector('.lb2-coach'); const tap = document.querySelector('.lb2-coach-tap'); const dim = document.querySelector('.lobby2-ftue'); const lobby = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lobby-screen]'); return 'lobbyMounted=' + !!lobby + ' coach=' + (coach ? 'PRESENT(BUG)' : 'absent') + ' tapCatcher=' + (tap ? 'PRESENT(BUG)' : 'absent') + ' ftueDim=' + (dim ? 'PRESENT(BUG)' : 'absent'); })()
steps._comment: REPORTED: the lobby IS mounted behind the modal (that's why this bug was possible) but its FTUE coach subtree must not be.

steps.expression: (() => { if (window.__sndSpy) { window.__sndSpy.played.length = 0; return 'reset existing'; } const spy = { played: [] }; window.__sndSpy = spy; const short = (s) => { try { return String(s||'').split('/').pop().split('?')[0]; } catch (e) { return String(s); } }; const nativePlay = HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play; HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play = function () { spy.played.push({ src: short(this.currentSrc || this.src), volume: Number(this.volume.toFixed(3)) }); return nativePlay.apply(this, arguments); }; return 'installed'; })()
steps._comment: Install the play() spy WHILE the modal is still up, so it can observe the quiet period.
Deliberate dwell. The typing loop chains a fresh play() call per clip (~0.5s), so 1800ms of silence cannot be an active loop we merely started watching late.

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__sndSpy; if (!s) return 'SPY MISSING'; if (!s.played.length) return 'SILENT (correct)'; return 'PLAYED(BUG): ' + s.played.map(p => p.src + '@v' + p.volume).join(', '); })()
steps._comment: ASSERTION 3 (reported): nothing at all may play while the user is being asked whether they want audio.
Visual check - no coach bubble behind the modal
